## Who am I in the shop?

Begin with a private mind map of interests, strengths, influences, goals, and the kind of work you want to be known for.

## How do I want my work to be known?

Think like the owner of a garage, race team, restoration shop, fabrication shop, or automotive brand. Your identity work becomes the starting point for a personal marque and shop log.

## NICE starts before the tools

Identify needs and necessities before building. Preparation is part of hands-on work, not something separate from it.
